description: Statistics Norway publishes the dwelling stock of every Norwegian municipality each year in StatBank. The statistics count inhabited and uninhabited dwellings by building type (detached house, two-dwelling house, row and linked houses, block of flats, communal residence and other), construction period in 13 bands, floor area, number of floors in the building, floor position, kitchen access, ownership and urban or sparsely built area. Table 06266 covers 994 regions for 2006 to 2026. The figures build on the Matrikkelen cadastre and other sources, and on 1 January 2026 the country had 2,762,504 dwellings. The statistics page was last updated on 3 March 2026. Format and access: interactive StatBank tables and the free StatBank API, which returns JSON-stat, without registration. Licence: SSB content is under CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: dwellings that were demolished or burnt down may remain if not reported to the municipality, recent changes can lag in registration, and the region list mixes current and earlier municipalities. Simulation uses: municipal building stock by type and age for exposure, energy retrofit and housing capacity models. Related records: the SSB municipal water supply and wastewater statistics, and the Danish BBR and Swiss GWR building registers.
